title: Peace, love and America growing up
summary: McBee reflects on whether peace is possible and says America is going through a natural maturing.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: The second line to the melody you were singing goes Peace and happiness — “the creator makes but one demand, peace and happiness through all the land.” And I’m wondering if you feel in this day and age that that’s possible?

Of course. It’s from whence it comes. We had an extreme deviation from that reality. Reality is love and love is true. That’s the message. It’s what causes the manifestation of all things. That’s our nucleus. That’s our soul. It’s always there. It’s a matter of how far you get away from it, which can lead you the wrong way you know. And I think the world at large now, this world of ours, is suffering a major distraction from that premise, from the soul of what America has always been about. I mentioned before about in Oklahoma, the love that I got from the community you know, and you know America, hey, I mean we’re diverse but one of the greater things that we are very, very conscious of and proud of is that there’s a great intense amount of love here, in various forms it takes. It has been distracted.

America, this is a wonderful place, man. Look at what we have here. You know everything that you can possibly imagine creatively and possibilities, you know, are here you know. I think that given other nations that have suffered through passages or situations socially, economically, whatever, for instance look at China. They suffered Japan’s situation. Look at the Greeks, the Italians, etcetera, etcetera. America is now right in the center of a passage. It’s growing up. This situation is causing us to be aware of not only who we are but ourselves individually. It’s a natural unfoldment of things. Every country goes through it. This is a very natural thing. This man came along and said hey, you know, you now have to become aware of who you are and what your intent is through the respect or acknowledgment of that person six feet away from you. What is all that about? This young country, America, is growing up, out of its teenage years. It’s just a natural unfoldment. It all depends on how we handle it.
So on your website I’m going to suggest that you add to your bassist/composer/educator, also philosopher, Cecil.
Oh no, no. No. I just say what I think it is you know, I’m not a philosopher.
